gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (trimmed pp4-5, two facing pages), Other financing sources (uses): 'Transfers to other funds' General Fund (204,377) p4, Other Governmental Funds (7,936) p5; 'Transfers from other funds' General Fund 7,936, Street Fund 57,071, Library Fund 22,932 (p4), Econ Dev Fund 6,000, Police Fund 94,635, Other Governmental Funds 28,239 (p5). Printed totals in the Total Governmental Funds column (not used): in 216,813, out (212,313) = JSON transfers_in / transfers_out. None of these fund-column cells was in detail. The only governmental transfer line in detail was detail[23], the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p12, a governmental-only schedule: departments General, Street, Fire, Library, Police, Community, Parks & Recreation, Economic development, Housing) 'Transfers from other funds' 4,500 = exactly the net of the six gross 'from' cells and two 'to' cells now added for the same governmental funds (216,813 - 212,313 = 4,500). It is the same money counted twice once the gross lines are in, so it is removed; the money is held by the eight added fund-column lines. Utility transfers out (Electric, Sewer, Water (1,500) each, p8) are already in detail and are not touched. Loan repayments (1,091 / 10,492 / 8,905) are already in detail as budget-schedule expenditure lines; loan proceeds print '-'.
